messages:
Jamal: Heads-up: we're getting a sustained spike in 5xxs from hosted inference in us-west1, model=redwood-large-v1. Alert flooded the oncall queue ~5m ago. Paging now.

incident-bot: [pagerduty] Page triggered: INC-2147 assigned to Alex. Priority: P1.

Alex: I'm on it. quick check — is this affecting all tenants or a subset? I'm seeing increased CPU and CUDA mem pressure on pool-gpu-a.

Priya: Looks like traffic signature matches a single customer (cust=acme-inc) with much larger batch sizes than usual; their requests are amplifying KV cache misses. Seen similar pattern in past week.

Sophia: Can you paste the top offending logs? I want to rule out model decode loop.

Alex: Pasting logs snippet and prom query:
```
# PromQL: 5xx rate filter
sum(rate(http_requests_total{job="inference",status=~"5..",model="redwood-large-v1"}[1m])) by (instance)
```

Alex: Top logs:
```
2026-03-07T17:02:11Z instance=pool-gpu-a-12 req_id=abc123 status=502 "kv cache miss and oom during matmul"
2026-03-07T17:02:12Z instance=pool-gpu-a-07 req_id=abc124 status=503 "backend timeout"
```

Priya: Agree it's localized to that customer and pool-gpu-a. Immediate mitigation: can we silence the noisy alert to stop pager churn while we triage? We'll keep a lower-severity metric alert to track customer impact.

Alex: I'll silence the alert for 30m and add a maintenance window on pool-gpu-a. Executing now.

Deckard: Maintenance window created: mw/1768001234-pool-gpu-a 30m.

Alex: Silence created: alert:inference-5xx-high model=redwood-large-v1 scope=pool-gpu-a duration=30m — reason: burst from single tenant causing pager noise.

Jamal: Thanks. Also please open a temporary router rule to split that customer's traffic to a separate, lower-priority pool so we don't impact other tenants.

Sophia: Routing change applied: cust=acme-inc -> pool-gpu-b (lower priority) via smart-routing v2. Validation: new requests show in pool-gpu-b logs.

Priya: After routing shift, 5xxs on pool-gpu-a dropped 92% in the last 2 minutes. Still seeing some slow tails on pool-gpu-b but it's within SLO.

Alex: Good. I'm going to start an on-call handoff to Priya for the post-incident cleanup and monitoring validation.

Alex: Handoff: I paged, confirmed mitigation (silence + routing + maintenance), created incident ticket: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/INC-2147, and queued a threshold review task. Priya is taking over.

Priya: Taking the handoff. Next actions: 1) validate silenced alert expiry and decide permanent threshold change or smarter alert (rate per-tenant vs global); 2) run a targeted load test simulating the customer's traffic to verify no regressions; 3) create/update dashboard with split-by-tenant KPI.

Jamal: For the threshold change, consider changing alert to "5xx rate per tenant > X" and add a secondary aggregate alert that has a higher threshold. We don't want single-tenant noise to page SREs.

Sophia: I'll draft a dashboard tile and a prometheus rule suggestion. Proposed rule (draft):
```
- alert: Inference5xxPerTenantHigh
  expr: sum by (tenant) (rate(http_requests_total{job="inference",status=~"5.."}[5m])) > 50
  for: 10m
  labels:
    severity: page
```
Replace 50 with a value from recent 95th percentile per-tenant baseline.

Priya: Good start. I'll compute per-tenant baselines and propose concrete numbers. Also will run a backfill alert simulation against last 30 days to see false-positive rate.

Priya: Backfill results: with threshold=50 we would have paged 3 times in 30 days (all during stress tests). With threshold=120 we get 0 pages but may miss real regressions. Suggest: two-tier approach: per-tenant alert severity=warning at 50, page at 120; aggregate global alert page at 500.

Jamal: That two-tier approach sounds sensible. Action items: Priya to land alert rule changes and dashboard, Sophia to add dashboard tiles and panel descriptions, Alex to remove temporary routing once customer fixes their client side batching, and Jamal to review and approve thresholds.

Priya: I'll open a PR for alert rules: github.com/redwood/infra/monitoring/pull/578 with test vectors.

Deckard: PR created and CI passed: infra/monitoring#578.

Alex: Quick note — re: maintenance window and silence: set to auto-expire. After we validate threshold rules, we'll delete the silence and rely on new rules.

Priya: Post-mortem note: customer was sending huge batch sizes; ops notified account team. We've asked client to throttle to recommended batch size.

Sophia: After routing change and silence expiry, we should run a synthetic end-to-end against a few sample tenants. I'll schedule a canary run tomorrow at 03:00 UTC.

Jamal: Final check before closing thread: are dashboards updated, PR merged, silences either removed or documented?

Priya: All done: PR merged, dashboard tile added (dash: inference/tenant-split), silence auto-expired at 1768003034 and maintenance window closed at 1768003100. Ran backfill, thresholds approved by Jamal.

Jamal: Verified metrics: 5xx rate back to baseline, no residual pager noise. Closing incident. Thanks everyone. :white_check_mark:

Alex: Leaving a short runbook note in INC-2147 for future: prefer per-tenant alerting + ephemeral routing as a mitigation pattern.

Sophia: Adding a follow-up: consider quota enforcement on batch size at the gateway to prevent amplification.

Priya: I'll create a small ticket for gateway quota: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/ENG-8092

incident-bot: Incident INC-2147 transitioned to RESOLVED by Jamal at 1768004469.

Jamal: Thanks — marking as post-incident cleanup complete.
